{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("Sample of revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print("Number of revenue entries with commas:", has_commas.sum())

# Display the first few entries with commas
print("Revenue entries with commas:", df.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].head(5).tolist())"}
